import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess

root = Path('/tmp/clonk-callback-lifecycle-performance')
repo = Path('/tmp/clonk-rs-callback-lifecycle')
data = json.loads((root/'timings.json').read_text())
comparisons = json.loads((root/'state-comparisons.json').read_text())
assert len(data) == 36 and all(len(run['frame_ns']) == 600 for run in data)
assert len(comparisons) == 42 and all(pair['equal'] for pair in comparisons)
cases = list(dict.fromkeys(run['case'] for run in data))
summary = []
for case in cases:
    values = {version: [statistics.mean(run['frame_ns'])/1e6 for run in data if run['case']==case and run['version']==version] for version in ['baseline','candidate']}
    medians = {version: statistics.median(means) for version,means in values.items()}
    summary.append(dict(case=case, run_means_ms=values, median_run_means_ms=medians, reduction_percent=100*(1-medians['candidate']/medians['baseline'])))
    for repeat in range(1,4):
        before, after = [next(run for run in data if run['case']==case and run['repeat']==repeat and run['version']==version) for version in ['baseline','candidate']]
        for key in ['scenario','seed','warmup','frames','loaded_objects','prepared_objects','final_objects','final_stippels','joined']:
            assert before[key] == after[key], (case,repeat,key)
aggregate = {}
for label,selected in [('all',cases),('without_stress',[case for case in cases if case!='stippels1000'])]:
    sums={version:[sum(statistics.mean(run['frame_ns'])/1e6 for run in data if run['version']==version and run['repeat']==repeat and run['case'] in selected) for repeat in range(1,4)] for version in ['baseline','candidate']}
    aggregate[label]=dict(repetition_sums_ms=sums,reduction_percent=100*(1-statistics.median(sums['candidate'])/statistics.median(sums['baseline'])))

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

baseline = json.loads((root/'baseline.json').read_text())
changed = json.loads((root/'changed-files.json').read_text())
changed += ['Cargo.lock','Cargo.toml','rust-toolchain.toml','.cargo/config.toml']
source_hashes={}
for path in changed:
    original=subprocess.run(['git','show',baseline['commit']+':'+path],cwd=repo,capture_output=True)
    source_hashes[path]=dict(baseline=digest(original.stdout) if original.returncode==0 else None,candidate=digest((repo/path).read_bytes()))
assert source_hashes['Cargo.lock']['candidate'] == baseline['sources']['Cargo.lock']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','content','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()==baseline['content']
artifact=dict(
    schema_version=1,
    measured_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    baseline=baseline,
    candidate=dict(binary_sha256=digest((root/'candidate').read_bytes()),base_commit=baseline['commit'],source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()),
    sources=source_hashes,
    environment=json.loads((root/'environment.json').read_text()),
    method=dict(pairs=3,warmup_ticks=100,measured_ticks=600,mode='Engine::tick including SimulationSnapshot',rendering=False,recording_before_initialization=True,players=2,order=[['baseline','candidate'],['candidate','baseline'],['baseline','candidate']],outliers_removed=0,concurrency=1,features=['presentation-capture','test-graph'],build_command='cargo build --release --locked -p clonk-engine --example callback_lifecycle_profile --features presentation-capture,test-graph'),
    harness=dict(source=(root/'harness.rs').read_text(),sha256=digest((root/'harness.rs').read_bytes())),
    orchestration_source=(root/'run.py').read_text(),
    summary_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    summary=summary,aggregate=aggregate,runs=data,state_comparisons=comparisons,
    validation=json.loads((root/'final-validation.json').read_text()),
    allocation_regressions=dict(warm_callback_before=54,untouched_teams_before=dict(empty=54,populated_64=183),unused_players_before=dict(empty=54,populated_64=64),nested_array_copies_without_fast_path=1024,nested_array_copies_after=0,final_output=(root/'allocation-final.log').read_text()),
)
output=repo/'benchmarks/results/callback-lifecycle-performance.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(artifact,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(summary=summary,aggregate=aggregate),indent=2))
